role: District Representative · Davao del Norte, 2nd District
summary: Davao del Norte 2nd District representative with 97 principal-authored bills. Authored an anti-dynasty ban and a tax exclusion for catastrophic-illness medical expenses. Co-authored a second anti-dynasty bill and a bill postponing the barangay and SK elections.
caveat: Economic evidence is a single issue and unscored. Postponement bill was widely co-sponsored.
